C1443.title: Large-Scale Measurement and Analysis of Blockchain Address Poisoning Attacks
C1443.summary: A large-scale two-year measurement on Ethereum and BSC identifies 13 times more address poisoning attempts than publicly reported. Attackers send small tokens to user wallets and exploit address similarity and temporal correlation to trick victims into copying poisoned addresses, stealing assets.
